product.name: Product Development
product.description: Development of advanced products for turbomachinery and steam boilers, focusing on power generation technology.

product.name: Performance Improvements
product.description: Engineering services aimed at enhancing efficiency and reducing emissions in power generation units.

product.name: Customized Solutions
product.description: Tailored solutions for power plant operators to improve cost efficiency.

product.name: Plant Construction
product.description: Services related to the construction, commissioning, and operation of power plants, including site and project management.

product.name: Consulting Services
product.description: Advisory services for power plant operators, including tendering consulting and technical offer analysis.

product.name: Troubleshooting
product.description: Assistance with operational issues in power plants, using root-cause analysis for various technical problems.
